steps: Apply the 0.2.0 tools, tests, workflow, ignore rules and documentation on a review branch.
Remove tracked generated exports and JSON schemas; keep only the README files in generated/ and schemas/. Retain any required historical artifacts outside source control before removal.

Keep the authored reference fixtures and examples/catalog/ inputs for regression tests. Replace live catalog registrations with adopted work as a coherent change; do not delete the native reference fixtures.
Install the development dependencies from pyproject.toml, run the portable gate and inspect the registry-driven matrix. Run each applicable pinned native lane before review.
Review the 0.2.0 folder and output policy and update the adopted template version after the migration is accepted.

Move each project to projects/<id>/ with native source under kicad/, firmware under firmware/, and board documentation/tests beside it. Move products to products/<id>/product.json with their own docs/tests.

Convert each split project record/config to one local project.json manifest and tests/contract.json. Make project paths local and keep shared dependency paths explicitly repository-relative. Select a catalogued toolchain ID.

Replace catalog/projects.json project lists with shared catalog paths and enabled project_roots. Keep the reference fixtures for isolated tool tests; opt their live/native lanes in or out through discovery roots.

Review training/development/production profiles. Development boards remain NOT FOR MANUFACTURE without requiring production release records. Preserve approved release BOMs and authored assembly inputs in Git as appropriate.
Run the full portable gate, inspect the automatic matrix and run applicable pinned native checks. Commit the reviewed layout and update adoption metadata to 0.3.0.

Update the shared tools, tests, workflow, templates and documentation while preserving template-adoption.json until migration review is complete. upgrade-plan reads the adopted version even when the upstream template contract changed.

For a fresh fork only, run tools.template init before adding designs. Existing adopters retain their live catalogs and projects; do not replace them with reference fixtures. Keep projects as an enabled discovery root.

The upstream scaffold uses 0BSD. Fresh bootstrap/init removes only its exact root LICENSE before company terms are chosen. Preserve adopter root licenses during upgrades and all required third-party notices; do not rerun initialization on established projects.
Review catalog/team-policy.json and project-local governance assignments. The default permits two actors with independent review. Match hosted branch controls to the named required checks.

Bind each electrical component reference to part_id in tests/contract.json when component identity is required. Complete schematic electrical contracts before production; diagram-only views use their typed product relationships.

Review board-local release_exports layer, origin and placement-unit settings. Commit source first, then regenerate portable/native reports and candidates with tools.release prepare; old PASS-only manifests do not satisfy release evidence requirements.

Keep working outputs and generated manifests under ignored build/. Use tools.release package and restore to retain exact outputs and source history. Preserve existing approved archives; never rewrite historical evidence to the new schema.

Preserve applicable licenses and attribution, and keep authored documentation images under docs/assets/. Run portable and pinned native gates, verify hosted acceptance and restore a package, then update the adoption record to 1.0.0 after review.
Move the policy environment to Python 3.12 or newer, recreate its virtual environment, and install the updated development dependencies.
Apply the 1.1 tools, tests, template contract and documentation while preserving live projects, catalogs, company terms and template-adoption.json until review completes.
Run tools.template doctor before editing. Existing forks do not rerun initialization; tools.template adopt is only the one-command path for a fresh template copy or fork.
Regenerate and verify a standalone release package when applicable. Record the package_sha256 emitted by tools.release package in the team's durable release-storage receipt.
Run the full portable and pinned native gates, verify hosted acceptance, then update template-adoption.json to 1.1.0 after review.
Apply the 1.2.0 Python tools, tests, dependency pins and template contract while preserving live projects, catalogs, company terms and template-adoption.json until review completes.
Recreate or update the policy virtual environment from pyproject.toml so SnakeMD 2.4.1 and snakemd-stubs 2.4.1.0 are installed together.

Move scaffold-owned repository guidance from docs/ into docs/workflow/, move organization-wide adopter documentation into docs/team/, and update links. Keep board and product documentation inside their existing islands.

Delete dated audit, rehearsal and acceptance snapshots after preserving any required evidence in the applicable pull request, CI run or release storage. Move the documentation policy record to catalog/documentation-policy.json.
Create and import a disposable project, inspect its generated Markdown, and prepare an engineering-review candidate when applicable.
Run the full portable and applicable pinned native gates, verify hosted acceptance, then update template-adoption.json to 1.2.0 after review.
Apply the 1.2.1 tools, tests, template contract and Python dependency declaration while preserving live projects, catalogs, company terms and template-adoption.json until review completes.

Recreate or update the policy virtual environment from pyproject.toml. Pydantic owns its published compatible pydantic-core requirement; do not add Pydantic transitive packages as direct pins unless repository source imports them directly.
Run the full portable and applicable pinned native gates, verify hosted acceptance, then update template-adoption.json to 1.2.1 after review.
Apply the 1.3.0 policy tools, templates, tests and documentation while preserving live projects, catalogs, company terms and template-adoption.json until review completes.

Use pcb_only only for an imported or layout-only board that has no authoritative matching schematic. It remains not for manufacture and cannot be selected for a product assembly or a non-review release.

Keep complete existing boards as pcb. For each pcb_only island that needs electrical or manufacturing authority, add or adopt its matching schematic, complete the independent component/net contract and migrate it to pcb in a reviewed change.
Run the full portable and applicable pinned native gates, verify hosted acceptance, then update template-adoption.json to 1.3.0 after review.
